answer: Gate influence with a slow-thaw admission bond. A new identity locks a fee that releases only like a glacier, one slice per epoch, and only after paid work settles with counterparties in three custody basins divided by a verification canyon (no shared keys or common operators). Voting and grading stay at zero until those receipts form a summit of independent attestations across successive epochs. Clone farms cannot jump the canyon with recycled counterparties: each fake identity pays a real locked bond and still fails the basin-diversity check.
